text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's good, it's really good...
It's packed with soul...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even looking at it myself gives me chills...
It's a masterpiece... Heheh, hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having poured her entire heart and soul into the manga,
Kiseki was left unable to move for a while.
